title: Accuracy Guardrail Harness with Adversarial Cohort Injection
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build an automated validation harness that runs candidate quantization profiles (FP8/INT8) through curated and adversarial prompt cohorts, computes a composite accuracy score across multiple metrics, and produces deterministic pass/fail gates that integrate with CI and rollout tooling.
background: We already run calibration and golden-prompt checks but coverage is narrow: model cohorts drift, bias-sensitive prompts and adversarial perturbations reveal regressions that slip through FP8/INT8 rollouts. This harness should broaden signal by injecting adversarial variations, computing embedding-level fidelity and task-specific metrics, and gating rollouts via a configurable composite threshold.
acceptance_criteria: Harness runs end-to-end for a model candidate with both FP8 and INT8 profiles and emits a deterministic verdict (PASS/FAIL)
Support for 4 cohorts: stable-goldens, edge-cases, adversarial-perturbations, and customer-sampled prompts
Composite score combines: semantic similarity (embedding cosine), exact-match / task metric (where applicable), and generation likelihood delta; weighting is configurable
Resulting verdict is written to a standardized artifact (JSON) and annotated to the model candidate in the release pipeline
CI integration: a failing verdict blocks candidate from promoted rollouts; passing allows canary stage with telemetry gates
Telemetry produced includes per-prompt metrics, per-layer sensitivity tags, and aggregated deltas, viewable in Console
Run time for a standard suite (2k prompts) under the dedicated CI runner must be under 45 minutes with sampling/parallelism settings
tasks: Design schema for validation artifact (fields: model_version, quant_profile, cohort_id, per_prompt_metrics, composite_score, verdict, run_id)
Curate adversarial perturbation generator: paraphrase, token-swap, punctuation-noise, context-truncation
Implement cohort manager to select balanced cohorts and preserve seedability for reproducible runs
Metric implementations: embedding cosine (reference vs candidate), generation-likelihood-delta, task-specific scorers (F1/EM/ROUGE where applicable), and diversity/degeneration checks
Implement weighting config and composite scorer with a fallback policy when task-specific metric not available
Integrate harness runner with model compilation step for FP8/INT8 and capture layer-level counters (cache misses, kernel fallbacks)
Emit telemetry events and wire to Console dashboards for per-route and per-model view
Add gating hook into CI: on FAIL, annotate PR and post message with top-10 failure prompts and suggested mitigations
Add canary integration: translate verdict into rollout policy (canary percent, rollback threshold)
Write end-to-end E2E tests and mock datasets for local CI

decisions: Use a composite scoring approach rather than single-metric gating to reduce false positives from outlier prompts
Embedding similarity uses OpenAI-style dense embeddings (1280 dim) with cosine threshold and fallback to token-overlap when embedding service is unavailable
Preserve deterministic seeds across adversarial perturbations so failing prompts are reproducible and can be triaged
CI block behavior: failing candidate sets release:blocked=true and comments top 10 failing prompts; Escalation to PM if high customer_impact
Run-time SLA: prioritize parallelism across CPU workers + batching in runtime to keep 2k prompt suite < 45m on CI runner
open_blockers: Finalize list of customer-sampled prompt cohorts (awaiting legal approval for sharing PII-masked samples)
Kernels telemetry: need an additional telemetry key from runtime team to capture kernel-fallback reason codes (PR requested)
Decision on embedding service fallbacks for offline runs (local vs hosted) - architecture sync scheduled 2026-03-12
links: Related Linear ticket: ENG-81337 (temporal-stability-probe) - for reference on cohort sampling
notes: We should avoid overly penalizing low-frequency customer prompts; introduce cohort-level weighting in composite score
Plan to include small human-in-the-loop review for first 5 failing runs to catch false positives before automated block policy is enforced
Long-term: correlate harness failures with downstream quality alerts in product logs to close the loop
gating_matrix: composite_score >= 0.87 => PASS (default weights: embed=0.5, likelihood_delta=0.3, task_metric=0.2)
If task_metric exists and drops > 3% absolute => FAIL immediate
If embedding cosine declines by > 0.12 on >5% of cohort => FAIL
If layer_sensitivity tag shows >10% of prompts with high-sensitivity on same layer => flag for manual review
Allow per-release tuning of thresholds via runtime-1.20 config
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (dev): run harness on historical candidates and produce artifact reports. No CI blocking.
Phase 2 (canary): integrate verdict into canary pipelines; failing candidates do not progress beyond 5% canary and trigger rollback if metrics cross runtime thresholds
Phase 3 (enforced): failing verdict blocks promote-to-prod and annotates PR with top failures and recommended mitigations
Phase 4 (monitor): correlate harness failures with production telemetry for 4 weeks to refine thresholds
